polity_name_1836: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
source_title: Union Flag (1801 pattern combining St George, St Andrew, and St Patrick crosses)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Acts of Union 1800 (39 & 40 Geo. 3 c. 67) & Royal Proclamation of 1 Jan 1801. Digital file URL and file-level license unverified in offline pass; classified historical_reference.

polity_name_1836: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
source_title: British Red Ensign (1801 pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Proclamation of 1 Jan 1801 establishing post-1801 maritime ensigns. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
source_title: Royal Standard of King William IV (with Hanoverian royal escutcheon)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Heraldic arms of King William IV (reigned 1830-06-26 to 1837-06-20), retaining the inescutcheon of Hanover until Queen Victoria's accession. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
source_title: Royal Coat of Arms of the United Kingdom under King William IV
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: College of Arms / Royal Warrant of William IV (1830-1837), featuring Hanoverian crown over inescutcheon. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: French Tricolore (Blue-White-Red vertical tricolor restored under Louis-Philippe I)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Ordinance of 1 August 1830 and Charter of 1830 Art. 67 restoring the Tricolore. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Coat of Arms of the July Monarchy (Charter of 1830 tablets variant)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Ordinance of 13 August 1831 replacing the Orléans fleurs-de-lis shield with the Charter of 1830 tablets. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: 24-Star Flag of the United States (13 stripes, 24 white stars on blue canton)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Flag Act of 1818 (3 Stat. 415); valid on 1836-01-01 until July 3, 1836 following admission of Arkansas (1836-06-15). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: 25-Star Flag of the United States (reflecting admission of Arkansas)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Flag Act of 1818 (3 Stat. 415); took effect 1836-07-04 after Arkansas admission on 1836-06-15. Star arrangement was not strictly prescribed by statute. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Great Seal of the United States (obverse coat of arms)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Resolution of the Continental Congress of 20 June 1782, reaffirmed by Act of Congress of 15 September 1789. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Russian White-Blue-Red Horizontal Tricolor (Merchant/Civil Ensign)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of Tsar Peter I of 20 January 1705. Served as merchant/civil ensign and de facto national flag in 1836 (black-yellow-white flag was only decreed in 1858). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Ensign of the Imperial Russian Navy (Blue St Andrew saltire on white field)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Naval regulations of Peter I (1712) and Naval Statute in force under Nicholas I in 1836. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Coat of Arms of the Russian Empire (Nicholas I era double-headed eagle)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Heraldic standardization under Emperor Nicholas I (pre-1857 Baron Köhne reform). Exact day of 1830 adoption unverified; digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Habsburg Imperial Flag of the Austrian Empire (Black over Yellow horizontal bicolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Proclamation of the Austrian Empire on 11 August 1804; dynastic Habsburg black-gold flag used as state/imperial flag in 1836 under Ferdinand I. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Austrian Merchant and Naval Ensign (Red-White-Red with crowned Bindenschild)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Imperial Decree of Joseph II of 20 March 1786; served as both civil/merchant ensign and war ensign in 1836 prior to the 1869 Austro-Hungarian merchant ensign. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Coat of Arms of the Austrian Empire (post-Congress of Vienna 1815 pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Imperial patent of 1815 following Congress of Vienna territorial settlement. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Kingdom of Prussia (Black-White-Black with Prussian Eagle)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Prussian Cabinet Orders post-1815 (King Frederick William III). Exact ordinance day unverified; digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Coat of Arms of the Kingdom of Prussia (1817 pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Prussian Royal Ordinance of 9 January 1817 establishing greater, medium, and lesser coats of arms. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Ottoman Flag (Red field with white crescent and eight-pointed star)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Nizam-i Cedid naval reforms of Sultan Selim III (c. 1793). Critically, in 1836 the star had 8 points; the 5-pointed star was adopted during Tanzimat in 1844. Provisional ID TUR. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Imperial Tughra of Sultan Mahmud II
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Reign of Sultan Mahmud II (1808-1839). Ottoman Empire did not adopt a European-style coat of arms until 1882; the reigning Sultan's Tughra served as state/imperial emblem. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: No official national flag existed in the Qing Empire in 1836
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Historical record of the Daoguang era (1836). The triangular Yellow Dragon Flag was only adopted for naval/diplomatic use in 1862 and rectangular in 1888; do NOT backport the 1862/1888 dragon flag to 1836. Provisional ID QNG.

source_title: Plain Yellow Banner (Upper Three Banners / Imperial Banner symbol)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Eight Banners military-administrative system of the Qing Dynasty (Plain Yellow Banner directly commanded by the Emperor). Used as dynastic/military identifier rather than a modern national flag. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: Đại Nam (Nguyễn Dynasty under Emperor Minh Mạng)
source_title: Imperial Yellow Banner / early Long Tinh Kỳ tradition (Minh Mạng reign)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Đại Nam Thực Lục (Minh Mạng era; country renamed Đại Nam in 1838/1839, officially Việt Nam in 1836). Standardized European-style national flags were not used in 1836; surviving illustrated Long Tinh Kỳ specifications date mostly from late 19th/early 20th c. Provisional ID DAI.

source_title: Siamese White Elephant inside White Chakra on Red Field (Rama II - Rama III ensign)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Siamese Flag Act / Royal chronicles of Rama II (c. 1817) through Rama III (reigned 1824-1851). Note: King Mongkut removed the chakra in 1855, leaving only the white elephant on red. Provisional ID SIA.

source_title: No official national flag existed in Tokugawa Japan in 1836
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Historical record of Tenpō 7 (1836). The Hinomaru was only adopted as the Japanese ship ensign on 2 August 1854 (Ansei 1) and national flag in 1870. Provisional ID JAP.

source_title: Tokugawa Clan Mon (Mitsuba-aoi / Three Hollyhock Leaves) Shogunal Banner
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Tokugawa Bakufu heraldic protocols under Shogun Tokugawa Ienari (1836). Used on shogunal vessels, checkpoints, and military curtains (jinmaku).

source_title: Imperial Flag of Brazil (19-star first imperial pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Imperial Decree of 1 December 1822 (designed by Jean-Baptiste Debret), with 19 silver stars surrounding the armillary sphere (20th star added in 1870). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Coat of Arms of the Empire of Brazil
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Imperial Decree of 18 September 1822 & 1 December 1822. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Mexican Republic (Green-White-Red vertical tricolor with uncrowned eagle on nopal)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of the Sovereign Constituent Congress of 14 April 1823 (removing the imperial crown of Iturbide and adding oak/laurel branches). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Provisional Revolutionary Flags of Texas (Dodson Tricolor / San Jacinto Liberty Flag)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Texas Declaration of Independence (1836-03-02). Multiple unit/provisional flags (Sarah Dodson tricolor, San Jacinto flag) flew prior to the first statutory national flag on 1836-12-10. Provisional ID TEX.

source_title: Burnet Flag (First National Flag of the Republic of Texas: gold star on azure field)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Act of the First Congress of the Republic of Texas approved 10 December 1836. Replaced by the familiar Lone Star Flag on 25 January 1839; do NOT backport the 1839 Lone Star Flag to 1836. Provisional ID TEX.

source_title: Spanish Red-Yellow-Red War and Fortress Ensign (Rojigualda, 1785 pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Decree of King Charles III of 28 May 1785; served as naval and coastal fortress flag in 1836 (extended to all army units and national flag by Royal Decree of Isabella II on 13 October 1843). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Carlist Royalist Banners (Burgundy Cross / Generalísima Standard variants)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: First Carlist War (1833-1840). Carlist forces used varied royalist banners, Cross of Burgundy variants, and religious standards without a single standardized national flag in 1836. Unverified canonical polity ID CAR.

polity_name_1836: Kingdom of Portugal (Reign of Queen Maria II)
source_title: Constitutional Flag of the Kingdom of Portugal (Blue-White vertical bicolor with Royal Arms)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of 18 October 1830 by the Regency Council of Terceira in the name of Queen Maria II. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (Red-White-Blue horizontal tricolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Decree of King William I of 19 February 1816 (reaffirmed 1937). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Kingdom of Belgium (Black-Yellow-Red vertical tricolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Constitution of Belgium of 7 February 1831 Art. 125 & Ministerial Circular of 12 October 1831 fixing vertical stripes with black at hoist. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: Kingdom of Sweden (United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway)
source_title: Swedish Flag (1815-1844 plain Nordic cross without union mark)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Decree of 6 June 1815. Note: the 'Sildesalaten' union canton mark was only introduced on 20 June 1844; in 1836 the Swedish civil/state flag had a plain blue canton. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway
source_title: Swedish-Norwegian Union Naval Ensign (1815-1844 swallowtail with red-white saltire canton)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Resolution of 6 June 1815 establishing a common naval war ensign for Sweden and Norway. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: Kingdom of Norway (United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway)
source_title: Norwegian Flag (1821 design without union mark)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Resolution of 13 July 1821 (designed by Fredrik Meltzer). In 1836 its maritime use was still restricted to northern waters until the decree of 11 April 1838. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Dannebrog (Flag of Denmark)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Danish royal maritime regulations of 1625 and 1748 codifying proportions of the Dannebrog. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Federal Standard of the Swiss Confederation (White cross on red square field)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Resolution of the Swiss Federal Diet (Tagsatzung) of 21 July 1815 adopting the white cross on red as the federal military ensign; formalized as national flag in 1848/1889. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Kingdom of Sardinia (1816-1848 Savoy blue ensign)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Patent of King Victor Emmanuel I of 13 January 1816; remained in force under Charles Albert in 1836 until replaced by the Italian Tricolore on 23 March 1848. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies (White field with Bourbon-Two Sicilies arms)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Fundamental Law of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies of 12 December 1816 (Ferdinand I); in force in 1836 under Ferdinand II. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of the Papal States (Yellow-White vertical bicolor with crossed keys and tiara)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Pontifical Decree of Pope Leo XII of 17 September 1825 establishing the yellow-and-white vertical naval/state flag; in force in 1836 under Pope Gregory XVI. Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: Kingdom of Greece (Reign of King Otto)
source_title: Royal/State Ensign of the Kingdom of Greece (Otto I era with Wittelsbach escutcheon)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Royal Decree of 4 April (23 March O.S.) 1833 adding the Bavarian Wittelsbach lozenge escutcheon to the crowned white cross on blue. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Qajar Lion and Sun Banner (Mohammad Shah Qajar era)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Order of the Lion and the Sun statutes (1808/1836) and Qajar court standards under Mohammad Shah Qajar. Field colors and sword addition varied prior to Amir Kabir's reforms (1848-1851). Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Khalsa Nishan Sahib / Battle Standards of Maharaja Ranjit Singh
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Contemporary European accounts and Sikh court chronicles of Lahore under Maharaja Ranjit Singh (reigned 1799-1839); saffron/yellow triangular or pennon standards with Khalsa emblems. Provisional ID PAN.

polity_name_1836: British East India Company (Company Rule in India)
source_title: East India Company Ensign (1801-1858 pattern with post-1801 Union canton)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Charter Act 1833 (3 & 4 Will. 4 c. 85) & Admiralty warrants for East India Company vessels; red-and-white horizontal stripes with 1801 Union Flag canton. Provisional ID EIC.

source_title: Hudson's Bay Company Ensign (Red Ensign with white HBC letters)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Hudson's Bay Company Archives (HBCA) post ensign records; British Red Ensign defaced with 'HBC' in white. Provisional ID HBC.

source_title: Flag of the Federal Republic of Central America (Blue-White-Blue with Federal Arms)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of the National Constituent Assembly of 21 August 1823 & Constitution of 22 November 1824. Intact in 1836 under Francisco Morazán prior to 1838-1841 dissolution. Provisional ID UCA.

source_title: Flag of the Republic of New Granada (Red-Blue-Yellow vertical tricolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Law of 9 May 1834 establishing vertical red, blue, and yellow stripes (distinct from Gran Colombia's horizontal stripes). Provisional ID CLM.

polity_name_1836: Republic of Peru (divided into North and South Peru in 1836)
source_title: Flag of Peru (1825-1836 Red-White-Red vertical tricolor with Peruvian coat of arms)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Law of 25 February 1825. On 1836-03-17 South Peru formed its own flag, and on 1836-10-28 North and South Peru entered the Peru-Bolivian Confederation.

source_title: Flag of Bolivia (1831-1851 Yellow-Red-Green horizontal tricolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Law of 5 April 1831 (yellow-red-green; red-yellow-green order was only adopted in 1851). Entered Peru-Bolivian Confederation on 1836-10-28.

source_title: Flag of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation (Crimson field with combined arms of North Peru, South Peru, and Bolivia)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of Supreme Protector Andrés de Santa Cruz of 28 October 1836 establishing the Confederation and its crimson flag. Provisional ID PBC.

source_title: Flag of the Argentine Confederation (Dark blue-white-dark blue with red Phrygian caps and Sun of May)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Federalist/Rosas-era vexillological usage (c. 1835-1850) featuring dark blue stripes and four red Phrygian caps in the corners. Digital file URL/license unverified.

source_title: Flag of Chile (La Estrella Solitaria, 1817 pattern)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Decree of Supreme Director Bernardo O'Higgins of 18 October 1817 (codified by Law No. 2,597 of 1912). Digital file URL/license unverified.

polity_name_1836: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman (Maritime Empire of Said bin Sultan)
source_title: Plain Red Flag of the Al Busaid Dynasty (Muscat, Oman, and Zanzibar)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Al Busaid dynastic maritime flag used across Muscat, Oman, and Zanzibar in 1836 under Said bin Sultan. Provisional ID OMA.

polity_name_1836: Eyalet of Egypt (Autonomous Viceroyalty under Muhammad Ali Pasha)
source_title: Flag of Egypt under Muhammad Ali Pasha (Red field with white crescent and star)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Vexillological records of Muhammad Ali's fleet and army in 1836. Note: the three-crescent-and-star Khedival flag was introduced later in 1867 under Isma'il Pasha. Provisional ID EGY.

source_title: Flag of the Principality of Serbia (Red-Blue-White horizontal tricolor)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Ottoman Imperial Firman of Sultan Mahmud II (late 1835) granting Prince Miloš Obrenović the red-blue-white horizontal tricolor. Provisional ID SER.

source_title: Flag of the Principality of Wallachia (Yellow-Blue horizontal bicolor with Wallachian eagle)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Firman of Sultan Mahmud II (1834) under Regulamentul Organic approving Wallachia's yellow-and-blue merchant/militia flag. Provisional ID WAL.

source_title: Flag of the Principality of Moldavia (Blue-Red horizontal bicolor with aurochs head)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Firman of Sultan Mahmud II (1834) under Regulamentul Organic approving Moldavia's blue-and-red flag. Provisional ID MOL.

source_title: Ka Hae Hawaiʻi (Flag of the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi)
creator: unknown
notes: Evidence: Hawaiian royal court records (c. 1816 under Kamehameha I; codified by Act of 20 May 1845 under Kamehameha III). Digital file URL/license unverified.
